decisions.reason: The copper-coated glass substrate is close to the firm's established offer, so it costs little to keep, and demand for glass packaging in 3D integration and high-frequency applications is still unresolved but promising, so keeping the option is worth more than its cost.

The laser-based through-glass-via structuring was only launched in 2024 and is prominently presented, and it fits the firm's strategic push into higher-value semiconductor packaging, so its uncertain upside justifies keeping it rather than dropping it early.
